# Accuracy analysis: css-wordpress-wordpress-autogenerated-file

Measured 2026-10-13 on main 3f7c2b64 (`benchmark_optimal_solutions`, `painting_failure_census`,
`mismatch_detail_for_fixture`, `painting_disagreement_detail`). The engine changes; re-measure
before relying on these numbers.

## Numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| Mapping mismatches | 0 (0 visible) of 16870 nodes, 16870 graded, N:M floor 0 visible |
| Painting, Minimal | 2 bytes wrong of 47021: renderer 2, matcher 0 |
| Painting, Full | 2 bytes wrong of 47021: renderer 2, matcher 0 |
| Ground-truth invariant violations | none |

## The change

A minified WordPress dashboard stylesheet (one 23,500-byte line after a header comment). In the
`.welcome-panel-close` rules, the commit adds `display:flex;align-items:center;`, shortens the
padding (`10px 15px 10px 24px` becomes `10px 15px`), and removes `position:absolute;top:8px;left:0;`
from the `:before` rule.

## Painting

The fixture has one painting (`Minimal`), so it is scored under both presets. Both runs are the same
with the human mapping. They come from the painting, not the matcher or the renderer.

- Delete -> None, 1 byte, line 2 column 3636: the `8` of `top:8px`. The painting deletes
  `position:absolute;top:` (columns 3614-3636) and `px;left:0;` (3637-3647) as two ranges and leaves
  the `8` between them unpainted. The whole declaration is removed, so this looks like a selection
  slip. omnidiff deletes it. `ground-truth`.
- None -> Delete, 1 byte, line 2 column 3491: the space before the removed `10px 24px`. The
  painting's Delete range `' 10'` starts with it. Painting rule 4 (text_painting_findings.md) says
  Minimal never paints whitespace at the ends of a range, and `diff::text::ranges_for_options` trims
  it. omnidiff paints the space inside `10px 24px`, where the painting agrees. `ground-truth`.

## Verdict

- Primary cause: `ground-truth`
- Other causes: none
- Where a fix would go: none in omnidiff; the painting (Marko's call).
- Ground truth questionable: yes: the Minimal painting leaves the `8` of the deleted `top:8px`
  unpainted between two Delete ranges, and its `' 10'` Delete starts with a space, against painting
  rule 4.
